purpose: Editorial numeric anchors and claim limits; no new inference
scientific_revision: Closed version inherited from final decision release 2026-09-21

claims.claim: The original finite PRKDC historical rule lacked stable priority support in the evaluated A549 AZD7648 campaigns.
boundaries: Not invalidation of DNA-PK
Missing labels are not failures
Comparators are source-not-called not established negatives
Matched diagnostic is not causal adjustment
Not independently recomputed in this build-spec turn

claims.claim: The prespecified crossed ordering for L2.32 versus L2.139 did not repeat in R2.
boundaries: Both contrasts remain positive under the declared removals; hypothesis failure is not numerical instability
R2 previously exposed, not an untouched prospective test
Not an olaparib-rucaparib difference validation
Failed hypothesis results must remain prominent

claims.claim: The shared v3 support has 19,174 eligible gene-transcript units, each with one physical dual-guide construct.
boundaries: Two guides per construct are not independent constructs
Same programme and selected background lines, no multi-clone causal generalization
Do not count array rows or tests as experimental N
19,230 v3WT-only units is a different support, not a correction

claims.claim: For the fixed M-C balance, expanding transcript and gene support changes the relative pathway ordering under both declared count transforms.
boundaries: S0/S1/S2 are different conditional supports/weights, not alternative estimates of one identical population
S2 is not corrected biological truth
Sequential decomposition is path-dependent arithmetic, not causal attribution
No absolute protection, therapeutic window, or novel mechanism
Counts are original integer exports; final run did not independently reparse HDF5

claims.claim: Endpoint level, baseline-to-drug change, and stress interaction are distinct reported-scale estimands.
boundaries: Parent-produced experiments, not user-performed wet lab
All five predefined Fig5d reagents including WRAP53 retained
No inference of equality from similar ratios
No absolute MFI/ATP decomposition or sample pairing not given
Main6f/g are subsets of Extended6d/e, not replication
No borrowing these selected-gene experiments as validation of M/C pathways

claims.claim: Relative control enrichment can coexist with lower normalized abundance than the predrug reference; fixed balances remain branch- and support-dependent.
boundaries: A,B,D=A-B are not three independent experiments
Relative guide abundance is not absolute cell number
Time is not population doublings
Independent SUM programme is not matching PRDX1/AZD7648 validation
86/57 own temporal support and80/15common support differ from finalv3S0 andS2

claims.claim: Do not escalate a stable pathway-specific protective target claim from these archived comparisons; deliver the completed source-bound research case.
boundaries: No no-go on entire DNA-PK target class
Not claiming all public screening is unreliable
No patent/clinical efficacy/target-validation claim
No target-selection based on selecting favorable support

global_forbidden_upgrades: independent laboratory validation unless explicitly supported
confidence intervals fabricated from gene or guide counts
all biology caused by pipeline artefact
portfolio author identity inferred from file paths
